description:
Outcome: Gardener reports a problem and coordinator resolves it, from brief.md First version must 4
Scope: Persist report bound to verified own current-season allocation, plain-text description/status, coordinator open list and idempotent resolve, creation timestamps for digest. Excludes: photos, chat and map
Acceptance: Receipt/report survive reload; another household cannot report against an unheld plot; coordinator sees open and resolved states
Behaviour: No-allocation explanation, accessible validation/errors retaining form, duplicate-submit protection, loading and retry
Verification: Report/resolve/permission integration and phone tests; seeded valid allocations permit development independent of T-006. Prerequisites: T-002, T-003. Assumptions: none
title: Plot problem reporting and resolution
